newsitem.title: UK: UK Lib Dems pledge 1p in pound income tax rise.
newsitem.headline: UK Lib Dems pledge 1p in pound income tax rise.

text.p: The Liberal Democrats said on Thursday their election manifesto will contain a pledge to increase income tax by one penny in the pound having decided Britain's finances required it.
This makes the LibDems the only mainstream British political party to favour a tax hike.

The party has long said it would raise the standard rate of tax to 24p in the pound if this was necessary in order to invest an extra two billion stg a year in education. Leader Paddy Ashdown told a news conference that the party had now looked at Britain's finances and decided that the tax increase would be necessary.
The LibDems are also pledged to introduce a 50 percent top rate on incomes over 100,000 stg a year in order to raise personal allowances. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
